# Consumer app generated by: python scripts/qwinui3.py init
# Packaging: subtree (Path A) — add_subdirectory this QWinUI3 clone.

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.21)
project(MyQWinUI3App LANGUAGES CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

# Point at your QWinUI3 checkout (sibling by default).
if(NOT DEFINED QWINUI3_ROOT)
    set(QWINUI3_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../QWinui3" CACHE PATH "QWinUI3 source root")
endif()
add_subdirectory("${QWINUI3_ROOT}" "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/qwinui3")

qt_add_executable(my_qwinui3_app main.cpp)
qt_add_qml_module(my_qwinui3_app
    URI MyApp
    VERSION 1.0
    QML_FILES Main.qml HomePage.qml
    IMPORTS
        TARGET qwinui3_theme
        TARGET qwinui3_extras
        TARGET qwinui3_platform
)
target_link_libraries(my_qwinui3_app PRIVATE
    Qt6::Quick Qt6::QuickControls2
    qwinui3_theme qwinui3_style qwinui3_extras qwinui3_platform
)
if(NOT QWINUI3_BUILD_SHARED)
    target_link_libraries(my_qwinui3_app PRIVATE
        qwinui3_themeplugin qwinui3_styleplugin qwinui3_extrasplugin qwinui3_platformplugin)
endif()
set_target_properties(my_qwinui3_app PROPERTIES RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}")
